notes: «حَدَّثَنا أَبي» — the father of the compiler, named only by relation (rule 7); the compiler is added by the tool
«قُلْتُ لِلرِّضا» is written with the preposition lām before al-; the Imam is read as the name «الرضا» (the tool matches the «لل» form)
«10 - نَصٌّ آخَرُ» is a numbering label and is left out
